##### Project general facts

Jenna 1 by Arada is the first phase of a contemporary residential cluster at the heart of the community, designed for modern families. The multi-section building combines smooth facades with thoughtful architecture that blends into the surrounding landscape and the lively urban setting, and rises above a basement level and a ground floor to the residential floors. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, positioned between a vibrant boulevard of shops and cafes and a peaceful landscaped park.

Residents enjoy exclusive access to a swimming pool with a relaxation area and a fully equipped gym, along with direct access to a landscaped park with modern sports courts, picnic areas and a children's play area. A boulevard lined with cafes, restaurants and boutiques sits at the doorstep, while a major shopping and entertainment destination with retail outlets, dining venues, a cinema and family attractions is a short walk from the building.

Every apartment is finished to a high standard and designed for comfort and practicality, with integrated smart home systems as standard. Sleek finishes, quality materials and bright, modern interiors create elegant living spaces suited to contemporary lifestyles. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances including a cooking range, a hood and a washer-dryer, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and making each home easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, schools, hotels, retail and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, while Madar Mall, Raffles World Academy, SABIS International School and the Arada central business district sit within walking distance of the building.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. University City is a short drive away, and Dubai International Academic City and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, while City Centre Al Zahia and Sharjah International Airport are close by for shopping and travel.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
